Replays tested on Pi

No replay has run on Pi. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about Pi.

What the Pi setup page says about coverage

Wrap gates the commands you route through it. Pi calls made any other way (a browser tab, an unwrapped script, a mobile app) never touch KYA. Coverage is exactly the set of invocations you wrap, no more.

Source: the Pi recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
